# Configuration reference

All options of the configuration file (`COLO_CONFIG`, or `config:` in the Helm chart).
Units are meters and degrees. See [configuration.md](configuration.md) for a guided tour and
[room-templates.md](room-templates.md) for layouts. Editors that support
`# yaml-language-server: $schema=...` can validate and autocomplete with
[`schema/config.schema.json`](../schema/config.schema.json).

## `server`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `server.publicUrl` | string (uri) |  | Public URL (e.g. https://xr.example.com). Its origin is always allowed for WebSockets. |
| `server.allowedOrigins` | string[] | `[]` | Extra allowed Origins for WebSocket connections. Same-host origins are always allowed. |
| `server.maxRooms` | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 100000) | `500` | Maximum number of rooms held in memory. |
| `server.maxStrokePoints` | integer (≥ 10000, ≤ 9007199254740991) | `5000000` | Whiteboard coordinates kept in memory across all rooms (about 10 bytes each); boards stop accepting ink when it is reached. |
| `server.trustedProxyHops` | integer (≥ 0, ≤ 10) |  | Proxies/load balancers in front of the app that append to X-Forwarded-For (e.g. 1 for AWS ALB, 2 for Google Cloud load balancers). Used to tell clients apart for passcode rate limiting; 0 uses the socket address. |
| `server.trustForwardedFor` | boolean | `false` | Deprecated: same as trustedProxyHops: 1. |
| `server.allowServerOverride` | boolean | `false` | Allow the `?server=` URL parameter to point the client at another sync server. |
| `server.csp` | `"off"` \| `"report-only"` \| `"enforce"` | `"enforce"` | Content-Security-Policy for the app page. Use report-only to find what a custom setup needs before enforcing. |

## `auth`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `auth.mode` | `"none"` \| `"trusted-headers"` | `"none"` | none: anyone who can reach the app may join (rooms can still have passcodes). trusted-headers: identity comes from an authenticating proxy such as oauth2-proxy. |
| `auth.preset` | `"oauth2-proxy"` \| `"custom"` | `"oauth2-proxy"` | Which identity headers to read. custom uses auth.headers. |
| `auth.headers.user` | string |  |  |
| `auth.headers.email` | string |  |  |
| `auth.headers.groups` | string |  |  |
| `auth.headers.name` | string |  |  |
| `auth.allowDisplayNameOverride` | boolean | `false` | Let SSO users change the display name shown to others. |
| `auth.admins` | string[] | `[]` | Emails that are hosts in every room. |
| `auth.allowNonLoopback` | boolean | `false` | Allow trusted-headers mode while listening on a non-loopback address (unsafe). |

## `branding`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `branding.productName` | string \| map | `"WebXR Colocation"` | Name shown in the lobby. A string or { en: ..., ja: ... }. |
| `branding.logo` | string |  | Logo URL, e.g. /room-assets/logo.svg or an https URL. |
| `branding.accentColor` | string | `"#2f80ed"` | Accent colour of buttons and highlights. |
| `branding.lobbyMessage` | string \| map |  | Text under the product name in the lobby. |

## `i18n`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `i18n.defaultLanguage` | `"en"` \| `"ja"` | `"en"` | UI language when the browser language is not supported. |

## `xr`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `xr.inputProfilesPath` | string |  | Base URL of the WebXR input profiles (controller / hand models). Defaults to jsDelivr. |

## `voice`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `voice.enabled` | boolean | `true` | Offer voice chat (WebRTC, peer to peer). |
| `voice.iceServers` | object[] | `[{"urls":"stun:stun.l.google.com:19302"}]` | STUN/TURN servers with static credentials. |
| `voice.turn.urls` | string[] |  | TURN URLs, e.g. turn:turn.example.com:3478?transport=udp. |
| `voice.turn.secretEnv` | string | `"TURN_SECRET"` | Environment variable holding the TURN REST shared secret (coturn static-auth-secret). |
| `voice.turn.ttlSeconds` | integer (≥ 60, ≤ 86400) | `3600` | Lifetime of issued TURN credentials (refreshed automatically). |

## `storage`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `storage.driver` | `"memory"` \| `"file"` | `"memory"` | memory: state is lost on restart. file: one JSON file per room under storage.dir. |
| `storage.dir` | string | `"/data"` | Directory for the file driver (a persistent volume). |

## `assets`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `assets.dir` | string |  | Directory served at /room-assets/ (logos, GLB models...). |
| `assets.allowedOrigins` | string[] | `[]` | https origins models may be loaded from. |
| `assets.maxModelBytes` | integer (≥ 1024, ≤ 536870912) | `26214400` | Largest glTF/GLB model (bytes) served and downloaded. |

## `rooms`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rooms.allowAdhoc` | boolean | `true` | Allow joining any room name (created on demand from adhocTemplate). |
| `rooms.adhocTemplate` | string | `"standard"` | Template for rooms created on demand. |
| `rooms.adhocTtlHours` | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 8760) | `168` | Delete stored state of ad-hoc rooms unused for this long. |
| `rooms.list` | object[] | `[]` | Predefined rooms shown in the lobby. |

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string |  | Room id used in URLs (?room=...). |

| `overrides.environment.light` | number (≥ 0, ≤ 5) | `1` |  |
| `overrides.rules.maxParticipants` | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 256) |  |  |
| `overrides.rules.voice.enabled` | boolean |  |  |
| `overrides.rules.permissions.clearBoard` | `"everyone"` \| `"hosts"` |  |  |
| `overrides.rules.permissions.resetObjects` | `"everyone"` \| `"hosts"` |  |  |
| `overrides.rules.permissions.editSettings` | `"everyone"` \| `"hosts"` |  |  |
| `hosts` | string[] | `[]` | Emails of people who are hosts of this room (requires trusted-headers auth). |
| `access.allowedDomains` | string[] | `[]` |  |
| `access.allowedUsers` | string[] | `[]` |  |
| `access.allowedGroups` | string[] | `[]` |  |
| `passcodeHash` | string |  | Hash from `npm run hash-passcode`. Overrides passcodes set by hosts in the app. |
| `unlisted` | boolean | `false` | Hide the room from the lobby list (people can still join by id). |
